wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 10-005 wires the mobj state-transition path via one src/vanilla facade (wireStateTransitions.ts) re-exporting the read-only ai/stateTransitions (aPain/aScream/aXScream/aPlayerScream/aFall/aExplode, PAIN_DEATH_ACTION_COUNT 69, wirePainDeathActions, context; SFX death ids, EXPLODE_DAMAGE 128, PLAYER_SCREAM_GIB_HEALTH -50) and the world/mobj setMobjState (P_SetMobjState) primitive + Mobj type. The mobj.ts StateNum/SpriteNum/MobjType const enums are intentionally NOT re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax). VANILLA_STATE_TRANSITION_INVARIANTS pins five rules (setMobjState drives all transitions; 69-action registry; A_Explode 128 splash; gib death below -50; fixed death sfx ids). The focused test exercises the constants, the callable transition primitives, the frozen manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral.
